roleContext.jobDescription: An online brokerage routes retail equity and ETF orders to exchanges and market makers. The Software Engineer works on the order-management services in Java, keeps order-state handling correct under partial fills and cancellations, writes contract tests for the routing APIs and supports the annual best-execution review with data extracts. Working knowledge of current Java versions is expected. The recruitment panel reviews a factual evidence summary for every applicant and decides on progression itself. The order-management team has six engineers and works closely with the exchange-connectivity and compliance teams. Services already run on Java 17, and the team plans to adopt the next long-term-support release next year. Releases go out weekly after automated contract and regression tests, and the best-execution extracts are due to compliance each January.

requirements.text: Develops order-management services in Java, including order-state handling for partial fills and cancellations.
Writes contract tests for internal routing APIs.
Holds a recognised Java certification or equivalent documented expertise in Java 17.
Produces data extracts for the annual best-execution review.
Resolves FIX session issues with the exchange-connectivity team.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Software Engineer, Order Management (Brokerage)

## Experience

- Developed the order-state machine for the equities order-management service at Penhallow Invest, covering partial fills, cancel-replace requests and end-of-day expiry.
- Wrote Pact contract tests between the order-management service and the smart order router, run on every merge to either service.
- Produced the order and execution data extracts for the annual best-execution review in 2023 and 2024, reconciling counts with the compliance team's figures before submission.
- Moved the order-management service from Java 11 to Java 17, replacing the date-handling library and updating the garbage-collector settings after load tests.
- Joined calls with the exchange-connectivity team to diagnose FIX session drops.

## Work samples

- Work sample: a pull request adding cancel-replace handling to the order-state machine, with a state diagram, unit tests for each transition and the reviewer's approval.
